answer: Proof-of-personhood vouching chains make Sybils pay in reputation. A new agent joins only when an established agent vouches for it, staking part of its own score; if the newcomer is later caught faking, the voucher loses that stake too. No one wants to be a safe haven for fakes, so vouches are scarce. An attacker can't float a river of identities in on one voyage: each fake needs a separate honest sponsor willing to risk real standing, and every exposure burns the whole chain.
